title: HEAD's daemon suite is red on this host: scoped criterion execution reports UNKNOWN/BLOCKED on win32 (4 files) and the migrate_down refusal precedence moved under the registry table (1 file)
description:

Filed by the governor 20:14Z after three unanswered requests to architects since 17:50Z; every daemon-area completion needs `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` green, so this gates the fleet. definitionOfDone: The UNKNOWN/BLOCKED outcome of scoped criterion execution on this win32 host is root-caused from the execution port's OWN containment result (quote the containment reason, exit code or missing prerequisite it records), not inferred: if a host prerequisite is missing (broker binary, sandbox feature, env), the port NAMES it in the evidence and the fixture fails with that name - never a bare 'did not prove all checks'; if the port is wrong on win32, the port is fixed. No `it.skip` / `runIf` that hides a production defect.

criterion-integrated.test.ts, goal-live-evidence.test.ts, goal-services.test.ts and j1-command-path.test.ts pass on this host at the landed sha under the platform expectation that is actually true for it: 6a7e7737's win32 branch stays if the run truly COMPLETES here after the fix; otherwise the expectation is corrected and the measured reason is recorded in the test.

implementationPlan.description:
LEASE FIRST, THEN REPRODUCE THE PORT-LEVEL RED. Call moe.acquire_resource on `full-suite-gate` and hold it through step 3 (RAM floor rule, and on Windows an in-use .exe cannot be overwritten - a peer suite mid-run would fail the rebuild or observe a swapped binary). Announce GATE START in chat with the UTC window.

With the lease held, reproduce the root cause the architect measured, so your own transcript carries it: from the REPO ROOT run `npx vitest run packages/runner/src/verification/criterion-check-executor.test.ts` and quote the received object for 'measures a real check through the published process boundary'. It MUST read `{containment: "UNKNOWN", exitCode: null, byteCount: 0, refusal: {code: "PROCESS_BOUNDARY_BROKER_REFUSED", layer: "BROKER_PROTOCOL"}}` (architect measured `Test Files 1 failed (1) | Tests 5 failed | 2 passed (7)`). That refusal IS DoD 1's quoted containment reason.

If instead you receive PROCESS_BOUNDARY_BROKER_UNRESOLVED or PROCESS_BOUNDARY_PLATFORM_UNSUPPORTED, the diagnosis has moved: STOP and moe.report_blocked quoting what you got. Do not proceed on a guess.

Also record the baseline for the path-attributed-baseline rail: run `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` at the merge-base tree and keep its failing-path list. No files change in this step.

BACK UP THE STALE BROKER, THEN REBUILD IT. The stale .exe is the DoD-1 drill fixture in step 6 - if you overwrite it without a copy the drill has nothing to point at.

First: `git status --porcelain dist/windows-job-native/release/moe-windows-job-broker.exe` (expect no output - `.gitignore:4` ignores `dist/`), then copy it to `%TEMP%\moe-stale-broker-<workerId>.exe` and prove the copy landed by SHA256 equality against the source in a SEPARATE call (a PowerShell copy can silently no-op).

Then rebuild, from the repo root, pinning the toolchain explicitly because rustup reads rust-toolchain.toml from the CWD and not from --manifest-path:

  cargo +1.96.0 build --locked --release --manifest-path packages/runner/src/platform/windows/native/Cargo.toml --target-dir dist/windows-job-native -p moe-windows-job-broker

This is the same invocation CI uses (`.github/workflows/cross-host.yml:293`). Confirm the artifact's mtime is now current and its SHA256 DIFFERS from the %TEMP% backup - that difference is the evidence the rebuild actually replaced the bytes.

WHY THIS IS THE FIX: `APPROVED_IMAGE_LAUNCH_OPCODE = 4` (windows-approved-image-launch.ts:5) is sent by every criterion check; opcode 4 (`ApprovedImageLaunch`, control.rs:63,77) landed in commit 31339efb on 2026-09-06; the on-disk exe is dated Aug 24 and answers UnknownCommand -> BROKER_PROTOCOL. `dist/` is gitignored so landing 31339efb never refreshed it. NOTHING LANDS FROM THIS STEP - it is a host artifact, not a tracked path.

PROVE THE REBUILD AT THE PORT, THEN SETTLE DoD 2's PLATFORM BRANCH. Still under the lease.

(a) Re-run `npx vitest run packages/runner/src/verification/criterion-check-executor.test.ts` from the repo root. Expect the count line to show 7 passed. The bad-digest arm must now refuse with layer `BROKER_APPROVED_IMAGE` (not `BROKER_PROTOCOL`) - that layer is itself proof the new broker understands opcode 4.

(b) Run the four DoD-2 files scoped, from `apps/daemon`, with the config the daemon package needs:
  npx vitest run --root . --config package.json src/criterion-evidence/criterion-integrated.test.ts src/goals/goal-live-evidence.test.ts src/goals/goal-services.test.ts src/goals/j1-command-path.test.ts
Quote the `Test Files N passed (N)` line - exit 0 alone is not evidence, and a run that finds no files also exits 0.

(c) SETTLE DoD 2 ON THE MEASUREMENT: if the run truly COMPLETES here, 6a7e7737's win32 branch (goal-scoped-close-test-fixtures.ts:91-95, criterion-integrated.test.ts:70-76) STAYS unchanged - that is the expected outcome and no test edit is owed. Only if it still does not complete do you correct the expectation, and then you must record the port's measured refusal code in the test. Never reach for `it.skip` or a `runIf` that would hide it.

Release `full-suite-gate` here (announce GATE END) if steps 4-6 will take long; step 7 re-acquires it. Release it on the failure path too.

FIX THE MIGRATE_DOWN PRECEDENCE AT THE SOURCE (DoD 3). In `apps/daemon/src/deployment/migrate-down-command.ts`, inside `createMigrateDownCommandHandler`, HOIST the composition check - the `databaseUrl`/`workspace`/`projectRoot` block that throws `MIGRATE_DOWN_UNCONFIGURED` (currently at :95-99) - so it runs BEFORE `const identity = migrationCommandIdentity(input, projectId)` (:93) and AFTER the operator-principal fence (:89-94). Keep the detail string byte-identical: migrate-down-journey.test.ts:78 asserts `"no database is configured on this daemon"` exactly, and asserts the fixture password `hunter2` never appears (epic rail 3).

DO NOT reorder anything inside `migrate-down-admission.ts`. `migrationCommandIdentity` is a pure admission function with no view of composition, and migrate-down-admission.test.ts:12-25 drives PROJECT_MISMATCH / TARGET_INVALID / REQUEST_INVALID through the handler on a CONFIGURED world, where the hoisted check falls through and those three stay green.

ADD THE SENTENCE THE GOVERNOR RULING REQUIRES, at the hoisted site: target admission runs first in every other case because `targetAggregateId` decides WHICH aggregate the command's durable version claim is made against, so it must be settled before any effect is reserved; but on a daemon with nothing composed there is no aggregate to revert and the operator's target is fine, so calling it 'target invalid' would be a substantively untrue refusal. Note in the same comment that the operator-principal fence still answers first, so an unauthenticated caller never observes UNCONFIGURED.

Verify scoped, from `apps/daemon`: `npx vitest run --root . --config package.json src/deployment/migrate-down-journey.test.ts src/deployment/migrate-down-admission.test.ts src/deployment/migrate-down-real.test.ts src/daemon-command-registry.test.ts` and quote the count line. daemon-command-registry.test.ts:1211 must now receive `MIGRATE_DOWN_UNCONFIGURED` for the :132 row.

MAKE THE PORT'S REFUSAL REACH THE FAILURE MESSAGE (DoD 1's second clause: never a bare 'did not prove all checks'). Today `executor.run` returns `refusal: {code, layer}` but both fixtures discard it, so the next host with a stale broker gets an unnamed throw - exactly what just cost this board a day.

(a) `apps/daemon/src/goals/goal-scoped-close-test-fixtures.ts`: build the executor explicitly and inject it. `createCriterionEvidenceService` already accepts one (criterion-service.ts:19,26 -> criterion-runner.ts:27,38); `@moe/runner` is a declared `workspace:*` dependency of `@moe/daemon` and criterion-runner.ts:2 already imports `createCriterionCheckExecutor` from the bare specifier, so no manifest edit is owed. Wrap it in a thin recorder that keeps the last non-null `refusal` and FORWARDS `close()` to the inner executor - criterion-runner.ts:161 is the only thing that closes it, and a dropped close leaks a broker process on every scoped-close test (epic rail 4). Then change the win32 throw at :91-95 from the bare `"scoped criterion execution did not prove all checks"` to a message that appends the recorded refusal (code and layer) when one exists. Use a plain wrapper object, not `vi.spyOn` - this module is a fixture, not a test file.

(b) `apps/daemon/src/criterion-evidence/criterion-integrated.test.ts`: the `execution` spy already exists at :32. INSIDE the win32 branch only (the non-win32 branch legitimately expects a refusal), before the existing `toMatchObject`, await every `execution.mock.results[*].value`, collect the non-null `refusal` values and assert that list is empty with a message naming the execution port. The refusal codes then appear verbatim in the failure output.

Do not change any passing expectation, any byteCount, or the non-win32 branches.

DRILL BOTH FIXES - a failure-path test that has never been seen red is not evidence.

(a) DoD 1 drill, ENV-ONLY, no tracked file mutated and therefore no restore-proof hazard: all four criterion test files already mock `windows-broker-path.js` to honour `MOE_TEST_APPROVED_BROKER` (criterion-integrated.test.ts:19, goal-services.test.ts:37, j1-command-path.test.ts:20, goal-live-evidence.test.ts:28). Set that variable to the %TEMP% stale-broker copy saved in step 2 and re-run criterion-integrated.test.ts and one goal-scoped file. Both MUST go red AND the failure output MUST contain `PROCESS_BOUNDARY_BROKER_REFUSED` / `BROKER_PROTOCOL`. Unset the variable and confirm green again. Quote both directions.

(b) DoD 3 drill: process-locally revert the step-4 hoist (edit, run, restore) and confirm daemon-command-registry.test.ts:1211 returns to `MIGRATE_DOWN_TARGET_INVALID`; restore and confirm `git diff -- apps/daemon/src/deployment/migrate-down-command.ts` shows only the intended hoist. This file is TRACKED, so `git diff` is a valid restore proof here.

Do NOT hold `full-suite-gate` during (b): it is an on-disk mutation, so announce the UTC drill window in chat instead, and keep it short.

FINAL GATE (DoD 4), ADVERSARIAL REVIEW (Skill `adversarial-self-review`), AND PATH DECLARATION (DoD 5).

Re-acquire `full-suite-gate`; announce GATE START. Run each leg as a standalone foreground command - never piped, never `;`-chained, because a pipe reports tail's status and a chain reports only the last command's:
1. `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` - quote `Test Files N passed (N)` and the failed count. `@moe/daemon` is apps/daemon; a bad filter prints 'No projects matched the filters' and still exits 0, so the count line is the only proof it ran.
2. `pnpm typecheck` - EXIT 0, plus a planted-error control in a NEW file to prove the leg is not incrementally short-circuiting; delete the planted file in the same session and show the clean re-run.
3. `pnpm test` (root lane) - free corroboration that packages/runner's criterion-check-executor.test.ts is green again. State plainly that the root lane covers NO apps/** files.
Release the lease on every exit path, success or failure; announce GATE END.

THE ONE PERMITTED RED, named as such: `apps/daemon/src/http/http-listener-read-dispatch.test.ts` 'the read-route roster and the surface it advertises agree in BOTH directions'. It is live peer dirt for task-33ceae56 (`/preview/read` retired on purpose) and is present as `M` in the shared checkout before your first edit. Quote its failing lines verbatim, name task-33ceae56 as the owner, and show it in the merge-base baseline from step 1 so the (2)-minus-(1) delta proves your diff did not cause it. Never edit, revert or stash it.

Adversarial pass: does the injected executor close on the throwing path as well as the happy one (does a scoped-close failure leak a broker)? Does the recorder survive concurrent criteria? Does the hoisted UNCONFIGURED check disclose anything a non-operator can reach? Is any drilled mutation still on disk?

Declare EXACTLY the files changed via complete_step.modifiedFiles / moe.declare_files: migrate-down-command.ts, goal-scoped-close-test-fixtures.ts, criterion-integrated.test.ts (plus nothing else - the broker rebuild writes only to gitignored `dist/`). Finally, leave ONE row comment recording the follow-up this row deliberately did not take: a broker protocol-version handshake in windows-broker-path.ts so a stale exe is refused BY NAME at resolution instead of at first launch. It is a follow-up item, not a new row.
